temporary.en: lasting for only a limited time

insufficient.en: not enough for a particular purpose

elaborate.en: having many carefully arranged parts or details
elaborate.zh: 精心製作的；複雜精細的

obscure.en: not well known; or difficult to understand

illegible.en: impossible or very hard to read

resilient.en: able to recover quickly from difficulty or damage
resilient.zh: 有韌性的；能迅速恢復的

dynamic.en: full of energy, activity, or change

satisfactory.en: good enough for a particular need
satisfactory.zh: 令人滿意的；符合要求的

dormant.en: not active now but able to become active later

vestigial.en: remaining from an earlier stage but no longer having a useful function
vestigial.zh: 退化的；殘留的；無功能的

common.en: happening often or found in many places

inadequate.en: not good enough or not enough for a purpose

ornamental.en: used for decoration rather than function

inactive.en: not doing anything; not working or functioning
inactive.zh: 不活躍的；無作用的；靜止的

replicable.en: able to be repeated with the same results

indecipherable.zh: 無法辨認的；難以解讀的

intricate.en: having many small parts connected in complex and detailed ways

distant from.en: far away from; not closely connected to

symbolic.en: serving as a symbol; representing something else

operative.en: working, functioning, or having an effect
operative.zh: 運作中的；有效的；起作用的

latent.en: present but not yet visible, active, or developed

deficient.en: not having enough of something; not good enough

attractive to.en: pleasing to someone and making them want to look or come closer

avertable.en: able to be prevented or turned away

avoidable.en: able to be prevented from happening

controllable.en: able to be managed or limited

corrected by.en: made right or fixed by someone or something

enticing to.en: attractive in a way that tempts someone

foreseeable and avoidable.en: able to be expected in advance and therefore prevented

inaccurate for.en: not correct or exact for a purpose or person

inevitable.en: certain to happen and impossible to prevent

irreversible.en: impossible to change back to a previous state

obscure to.en: unclear or hard for someone to understand
obscure to.zh: 使…難以理解的；對…而言模糊的

preventable.en: able to be stopped before it happens

resistant to.en: not affected or harmed by something; opposing something
